payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Change the black DVD to white while retaining its identity as a DVD.
outcome.target: The DVD is visibly white rather than black.
outcome.reference: The black DVD in the input image.

check.question: Is the DVD visibly white rather than black?
check.complete_when: The DVD is clearly white, fulfilling the requested color transformation.
check.partial_when: A visible portion or region of the DVD has been changed toward white, but the DVD is not fully white.
check.absent_when: The DVD remains black with no visible progress toward white.
check.unknown_when: The DVD or its color cannot be assessed confidently from the available evidence.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image shows a white disc where the DVD was, indicating progress toward the requested color change.
